summary: Frontend-only i18n testing for Multi-Language Engine across Landing + Booking + GlobalNav. All 16 assertions passed (100%). Verified: 9 language options in switcher, English default, Hindi/Tamil landing translation, localStorage persistence ('airyatra_lang'), reload persistence, booking page full translation (headers, step indicator, Step 1 aircraft/passenger UI, Step 2 dropdowns including OPTION values e.g. 'शादी'/'લગ્ન'), validation toast translation (EN and HI), GlobalNav Back/Home/switcher on /booking, and mid-form language switch to Gujarati without losing form state (helicopter selection + step 2 retained).
seed_data_creation: None; public pages tested without auth
